**Summary**


Resideo’s Scott Harkins joined the Appetite for Construction podcast to discuss how Honeywell Home smart thermostats, Resideo Pro-IQ™ services, and AI-powered predictive HVAC insights help contractors improve service efficiency, create new service opportunities, and strengthen customer relationships.


# Appetite for Construction Podcast: Scott Harkins on AI and the Future of HVAC Service


## Resideo’s Scott Harkins discusses how AI-powered insights, smart home technology, and Pro-IQ™ services are helping HVAC contractors shift from reactive to proactive service

11/16/26


Scott Harkins, Senior Vice President of Sales and Marketing at Resideo, joined hosts and industry trend spotters Tim Ward and John Mesenbrink on the Appetite for Construction podcast to discuss how connected home technology and AI-powered insights are helping HVAC contractors address three of the industry’s biggest challenges: labor, leads, and loyalty. Harkins highlights how solutions like the[Honeywell Home ElitePRO™ smart thermostat](https://www.honeywellhome.com/products/elitepro-s1200-smart-thermostat) and Resideo[Pro-IQ™ services](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/proiq/) can help contractors streamline installations, identify potential HVAC issues early, and build strong customer relationships through proactive maintenance.
